# Alma Consort

> Alma Consort is a professional chamber choir based in London. We perform Renaissance polyphony, contemporary commissions, jazz arrangements, and popular repertoire, both on the concert platform and in the recording studio. The ensemble is directed by Luca Wetherall and Izzy Mohan.

The Alma Consort runs studio recording sessions for composers, producers, record labels, and creative agencies, with audio and video production handled in-house. The ensemble also performs concerts and takes on collaborative projects.

Weddings, funerals, carol services, and private events are handled by our sister service, London Choral Service (https://londonchoralservice.com/).

The Alma Scholars programme supports early-career singers with mentoring, performance experience, and free studio recordings for their portfolios.

## Key facts

- Type: Professional chamber choir
- Location: London, United Kingdom
- Directors: Luca Wetherall, Izzy Mohan
- Repertoire: Renaissance polyphony, Baroque, Classical, Romantic, contemporary commissions, jazz arrangements, popular music
- Services: Concert performance, choral recording (studio and on-location)
- Sister service: London Choral Service (https://londonchoralservice.com/) — weddings, funerals, carol services, private and corporate events
- Mentoring: Alma Scholars programme for early-career singers
